frame: aurora_chamber scene frame, mm: x from the antechamber-end wall, y from the open side, z up from the deck

robot_pose.source: Epson's T6-B602S CAD fitted to the SAM 2.1 silhouette in Overhead 1 (robot zone, half resolution), with J2 and J3 held near the two-view fit of the hand-built outline (scene.ROBOT; 60 mm prior)

cables.note: traced by colour in the published stills and lifted onto the model's depth (cables.py): right in the view they were traced from, lying on the surfaces under them from others

glovebox.note: 1200 x 1120 x 790 mm interior, sloped long windows (57 and 60 mm lean); window openings 1100 x 710 mm with welded studs every ~95 mm (acorn nuts outside); no glove ports where the chamber model assumes them (the frames show clear window there)

antechamber door.note: hub and rim back-projected onto the wall plane from Overhead 2: radius 180-190 mm, matching the 15-inch antechamber (datasheet 190 mm)

QR sign.note: bottom edge back-projected onto the wall from Overhead 2; the top is out of view; texture rectified from the 18:22 UTC Overhead 2 still (only its lower part is in view)

ducts.note: Panduit Type G 1 x 2 in slotted duct (32 x 54 mm, fingers on a 12.7 mm pitch, cover off as in the frames), along the edges seen in both views

breadboards.note: edges back-projected onto their planes; Thorlabs metric skin with M6 holes on 25 mm, 12.5 mm from the edges (the hole rows measure 24.5-26.4 mm at these heights); sizes rounded to Thorlabs metric sizes where the edges are hidden

chip tray.note: 6 x 10 pockets fitted in both views; pitch 9.5 mm, centre and yaw from the joint calibration; chips placed per pocket from chip_tray.json (3 empty, 1 rotated); pockets 0.8 of the pitch and 3 mm deep (estimate); the handwritten edge is a texture rectified from Overhead 1

gantry.note: posts (147 mm), plate edge, both screw axes and the Y motor back-projected from Overhead 2 at their heights; NEMA 23 (57.2 mm) and NEMA 17 (42.3 mm) to the NEMA flange drawings; SFU1605 screws (16 mm, 5 mm lead) on BK12/BF12 supports, HGR15 rails and blocks (catalogue sizes); chain links 26 x 18 mm on a 17 mm pitch (igus-style, estimate)

ClearPath.note: Teknic's STEP for the CPM-231x (keyed shaft), from teknic.com without a login; identified by its pin-fin rear cap, QR label and status LED; placed where the hand-built unit was (back-projected from Overhead 1); the stack length (231x) is assumed

exfoliator.note: reel centres triangulated; housing, motors and stage back-projected from Overhead 1; reel diameter 85-95 mm from the image size at the triangulated distance; reel hubs with a 12-spline bore and the pin-fin drive from Overhead 2 and Overhead 1 close-ups (estimate)

microscope.note: BX3-URA, U-DP and U-TLU from Evident's own CAD (appearance models, STEP from Evident's OEM downloads, fetched at build time; evident_cad.py), stacked on the optical axis; ASI OE-1250 stage size; positions from the objective on the Overhead 1 ray at z 250, elevated breadboard back-projected at z 380, Thorlabs platform front edge at z 180-220; fillets, drum scale, objective profile and the THORLABS mark from the Overhead 1 frame (estimate)

tape measure.note: back-projected onto the deck from Overhead 2; case about 90 x 90 x 50 with a black bumper (FatMax-style, estimate)

cameras.note: Amcrest IP5M-T1179EW ball (85 mm, datasheet) at each camera's calibrated centre, facing its view direction; the turret base and mount are out of view and not modelled

end effector.note: from the AURORA video's Sample Transfer shot (2026-07) and a Borys lab photo of this T6: collar, body, tubing loop and parallel gripper, scaled from the ø20 mm J3 shaft; tubing into the hollow shaft's top; not visible in the November stills

epson.note: Epson's own T6-B602S CAD (STEP from Epson's support page, meshed per link; fetched at build time, not redistributed as STEP), posed by fit_epson_cad.py: Overhead 1 silhouette with J2/J3 held near the two-view outline fit; the EPSON wordmarks are Epson's own relief, coloured; badge and labels as decals (typeset, positions estimated from Overhead 1); the black unit on arm 2 is placed from Overhead 2, make unknown
